svg.text: Proposal, not running UI · reference: Raycast, Vicinae and KRunner · a keyboard launcher, separate from the start menu · uses the accepted surfaces, 8/12 radii, Inter and Hack
Apps, open windows, settings pages, files and commands, all
ranked in one list as you type.
A calculator and unit conversion answer inline, with no
Recent choices rank higher. All of it stays local; nothing
Meta or Alt+Space opens it, configurable in Meridian. Esc or
Every row works from the keyboard. Ctrl+K lists more
actions, such as Open with, Copy path or Run as root.
Tab narrows to one kind of result. A leading > runs a
Useful everywhere, and especially in a future window-manager
It sits beside the start menu and does not replace it.
Opens in 120 ms at a fixed spot in the upper third, and
grows downward so the search field never moves.
Requires: Meta key support, a global shortcut setting, a bounded file index or live search, and a bounded expression evaluator. Run as root goes through the normal authentication.
Prism was the theme tools name; theming and appearance now belong to Meridian. Names and samples are illustrative.
